quota.title: Plan builds
quota.subtitle: Syn can build {{limit}} workout or meal plans a month. Everything else in the app is free.
quota.reset: Builds reset on {{date}}, at the start of the month (UTC).
quota.deviceCount: Counted on this phone for now. Syn's server keeps the official count, which has the final say (for example if you also build plans on another device) and shows here after your next request to Syn.
quota.counts: Asking Syn to build a workout plan or a meal plan. Chatting, reviewing a plan, adding it to your schedule and undoing it never use one.
quota.failed: A build counts once Syn starts on it, even if it stops to ask you something first or the attempt fails, so check your connection before trying again.
quota.refunded: A build that fails before Syn replies (no connection, a server error, a reply cut off) is given back. One Syn answers still counts, even if it stops to ask you something first.
quota.more: Extra plan builds are not available yet. Your allowance renews next month.
